item.subject: science
item.stem:
Multiple choice question: Meena lives in Jaipur, where the climate is hot and dry, and her cousin Arjun lives in Shimla, where it snows in winter. Meena notices that the plants and animals around her home are very different from those Arjun sees near his home. Which of the following best explains this difference ( )
A. Plants and animals in each place are different only by chance; the conditions of a region do not matter.
B. The conditions of each region, such as water availability and temperature, are different, so different kinds of plants and animals live there.
C. Desert plants and animals cause the desert to have very little water.
D. No plant or animal can live in more than one kind of region, because conditions differ.

options.A: Plants and animals in each place are different only by chance; the conditions of a region do not matter
options.B: The conditions of each region, such as water availability and temperature, are different, so different kinds of plants and animals live there
options.C: Desert plants and animals cause the desert to have very little water
options.D: No plant or animal can live in more than one kind of region, because conditions differ
